title: Litecoin Founder Charlie Lee on the Rise of Stablecoins
description:
Litecoin founder Charlie Lee joins Coinage to talk through what the “institutional era” of crypto  means for an OG network built for payments — and why he still frames Litecoin as “silver to Bitcoin’s gold.”

We dig into what’s changed this cycle with ETFs and digital asset treasury companies, why Lee says Litecoin’s low fees and fast settlement keep it well positioned to win on payments.

Then we tackle a big narrative shift: are stablecoins replacing the transaction use-case we once thought Bitcoin (and Litecoin) would dominate? Lee explains why he thinks stablecoins actually help Bitcoin and Litecoin adoption — and uses a credit card vs. cash analogy to frame where crypto payments still win.

We also get into privacy — why Lee believes “financial privacy” is essential even for everyday, non-illicit spending, and how Litecoin’s MWEB privacy extension fits into the next chapter of adoption. Plus: how Lee thinks about market volatility, the risks of centralized accumulation (Strategy-style treasuries and custodians), where real usage is happening globally, and what “winning” looks like for Litecoin over the next 2–5 years.

Lee explains why he thinks stablecoins actually help Bitcoin and Litecoin adoption — and uses a credit card vs. cash analogy to frame where crypto payments still win. We also get into privacy — why Lee believes “financial privacy” is essential even for everyday, non-illicit spending, and how Litecoin’s MWEB privacy extension fits into the next chapter of adoption. Plus: how Lee thinks about market volatility, the risks of centralized accumulation (Strategy-style treasuries and custodians), where real usage is happening globally, and what “winning” looks like for Litecoin over the next 2–5 years.
